All three review lenses ran successfully.

findings.problem: ChatModelImageGenerator.edit() line 188 calls `part.get('image_url', {}).get('url')` which raises AttributeError when a response part carries `image_url` as a plain string rather than a dict. The same pattern exists in generate() at line 161.
findings.impact: If the LangChain Vertex AI adapter returns an image_url part where the value is a bare URL string (rather than the expected {'url': '...'} dict), an AttributeError propagates uncaught through the tool layer, bypassing the ValidationException contract and surfacing a raw exception to the caller.
findings.recommendation: Guard the dict access in both edit() and generate(): `if isinstance(part.get('image_url'), dict) and (url := part['image_url'].get('url')):`. This matches the edge-case guard snippet provided by the edge-case lens at image_generator.py:188.
